map.📖 查看「咨询（投资/可行性/风险）分析 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Investment, Feasibility and Risk Advisory User Guide"
map.填写初始投资额与折现率，逐行输入「年度,净现金流」。NPV＝Σ各期净现金流÷(1: Enter the initial investment and the discount rate, then one line per year as "year,net cash flow". NPV = Σ net cash flow ÷ (1 + discount rate)^period − initial investment; IRR is solved by bisection for the rate that makes NPV = 0; payback is interpolated at the point where cumulative cash flow first covers the investment. A positive NPV means feasible.
map.净现金流（每行「年度,净现金流」）: Net cash flow (one line per year as "year,net cash flow")
map.📚 深度解析：投资可行性与风险怎么测算: 📚 In-depth: Measuring Investment Feasibility and Risk
map.地产投资立项前，按预计年度净现金流测算 NPV 与 IRR，判断项目是否值得推进: Before approving a property investment, project yearly net cash flow to compute NPV and IRR and judge whether to proceed.
map.咨询顾问在可行性报告中给出静态与动态回收期，帮助决策方评估资金回收速度。: Advisors give static and dynamic payback in feasibility reports so decision makers can gauge how fast capital comes back.
map.方案比选时用同一折现率测算多个方案的 NPV，排序后推荐最优方案。: In scheme comparison, apply one discount rate across options, rank them by NPV and recommend the best.
map.初始投资 5000000、折现率 8%，现金流「Y1,1200000；Y2,15: Initial investment 5000000, discount rate 8%, cash flow "Y1,1200000; Y2,1500000; Y3,1800000; Y4,1600000; Y5,1200000": NPV is 818764.98 and IRR about 13.94%; static payback 3.31 years and dynamic payback 4.00 years, so it is judged feasible.
map.NPV 为正就一定可行吗？: Does a positive NPV mean it is definitely feasible?
map.NPV 为正是财务可行的必要条件，但还需结合资金约束、政策与市场风险综合判断，不: A positive NPV is a necessary condition for financial feasibility, but funding constraints, policy and market risk must also be weighed; no single indicator decides it.
map.工具用二分法在 −90%~200% 区间求解使 NPV 等于 0 的折现率；若区: The tool bisects between −90% and 200% for the discount rate that makes NPV zero; if both endpoints share the same sign it shows an out-of-range hint instead of a figure.
map.动态回收期显示未收回是什么意思？: What does it mean when dynamic payback shows not recovered?
map.表示按给定折现率折算后，计算期内的累计折现现金流仍不足以覆盖初始投资，需要延长计: It means that after discounting at the given rate, cumulative discounted cash flow within the study period still falls short of the initial investment; extend the period or revise the scheme.
